cr_data.provenance:
Purchased by Walter Beardsley from Downtown Gallery, New York City in 1958 
Gifted to Raclin Murphy Museum of Art (then Snite Museum of Art) in November 1978 
(Source: Raclin Murphy Museum of Art, 2025)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive. Abiquiú Notebooks after 1977 indicates, "Sold by Halpert to Beardsley Dec. 1958." Titled *Blue I* by O'Keeffe on Abiquiú Notebooks photograph. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Blue I

credit_line: Raclin Murphy Museum of Art, University of Notre Dame. Gift of Mr. Walter R. Beardsley, 1978.073.001
description: A softly shaded band of dark blue paint runs down the center of the canvas. Two gray stripes frame the blue one, and two bright white ones run along the edges of the composition. A wisp of smoke runs diagonally across the image.
